messages:
sofia: Quick spike — thinking about a different default for the Usage page. Screenshot: https://img.redwood.dev/ux/usage-spike.png. Proposal: default to org-rollup view with a prominent project selector, instead of defaulting to project. Thoughts?

mike: I like org-first for billing teams. Most customers call support asking where their org totals are.

kevin: UX note: if we show org-rollup, we need clear visual hierarchy so users don’t assume project numbers are global. Maybe a pill that says "Viewing: Org — Acme Corp" above charts.

jamal: Technical: org-rollup is heavier on the backend because we aggregate across projects. Need to ensure cached rollups or async loading for large orgs. Can we lazy-load project breakdowns?

sofia: yes lazy-load project list on open. For the charts, proposal: top row = 3 KPIs (Total spend, Avg tokens per call, Active projects), middle = trend line (7/30/90 day toggle), bottom = stacked bar for token breakdown (prompt vs completion vs system), and a side panel for invoices.

alex: Invoice placement: we should keep a persistent "Billing statements" CTA in header. People look for invoices immediately. Also rename "Download invoice" -> "Download statement (PDF)" in copy.

kevin: Copy tweak: "Org rollup" might be jargon. Suggest "Organization overview" or "Account summary". Also accessibility: don’t rely on color alone on the stacked bars — add hatch patterns or text percentages on hover.

ux-bot: Accessibility check: contrast of teal on white fails AA for 12px labels. Suggest darker #005f6b or increase font weight.

jamal: For the token breakdown we can precompute per-project deltas and store daily aggregates. That should make org rollups near-instant for typical org sizes. For giant orgs we can show progressive loading.

sofia: Good — progressive loading with skeletons. Another ask: what should be the URL/query param for toggling scope? /usage?scope=org vs /usage?scope=project-<id>? We need consistent deep links for dashboards.

mike: Use /usage?scope=org and /usage?project=proj-123. Keep param names explicit.

kevin: Wireframe nit: when switching scope, animate the KPI numbers rather than swapping the whole layout. Less jarring. Also small CTA to "Compare projects" next to the KPI row.

alex: On invoices: show last 3 statements inline with quick-download and a small status (paid/pending). But billable breakdown needs a toggle: show combined line items vs per-project line items.

sofia: UX question for product: default toggle state for the line-item breakdown? Org-admins want combined by default, but devs may expect per-project. Maybe add a remembered preference per user.

mike: Remembered preference makes sense. Default to org for org-admins, project for project-level users.

designbot: quick CSS snippet for the pill accessibility: ```css .scope-pill{background:#005f6b;color:#fff;padding:6px 10px;border-radius:999px;font-weight:600} ``` Also add aria-live region when scope changes: `aria-live=polite`.

kevin: Love the snippet. Also include an aria-label on the chart toggle: `aria-label="Trend period selector"`.

sofia: Small copy proposal: change tab name "Usage" -> "Usage & Billing" (so users know invoices live here). Opinions?

jamal: Fine backend-wise. Might make the nav wider.

mike: Agree, "Usage & Billing" is clearer. :thumbsup:

kevin: Quick question about CSV download placement — should be near the chart controls, not buried in the invoices panel.

sofia: Yes. Charts have a kebab menu with "Download CSV" and "Export PNG". Invoices have separate PDF download.

alex: Also add a small tooltip on invoice lines: "Includes usage charges, reserved capacity commits, and discounts." People ask what line items are.

sofia: Accessibility & keyboard flow: ensure filters are tabbable and that changing the scope doesn't trap focus. Add a "Back to projects" button in focus order.

ux-bot: Accessibility test reminder: run Axe on the page and verify keyboard-only nav and screen reader announcements for scope changes.

mike: Next steps: kevin to update wireframes with org-pill, KPIs, and invoices CTA; jamal to outline caching strategy; alex to draft invoice copy; sofia to prototype interactions. Can we get mock by EOD Friday?

kevin: Will do. Posting updated frames in this thread when ready.

sofia: Quick poll — vote with emoji: :one: org-default, :two: project-default.

mike: :one:

jamal: :one:

alex: :one:

kevin: :one:

sofia: Thanks all — will follow up with mocks and accessibility checklist.
